Triggers.When: WEATHER Here Rain Storm, LOCATION_IS_OUTDOORS Here
Triggers.Summary: {farmer} was walking around {location} in the pouring rain, completely soaked.
Triggers.Reaction: Tease {farmer} a little about being out in this weather, then show you care.

Triggers.Summary: {farmer} was still out and about after midnight, looking like they should be in bed.
Triggers.Reaction: You are a little worried. Tell {farmer} to get some rest, and hand them a coffee for the walk home.

Triggers.Summary: {farmer} walked past {npc} carrying a prismatic shard, glowing in every color.
Triggers.Reaction: You cannot hide your fascination with the prismatic shard. Ask where they found it.
You are openly offended by this gift. Ask {farmer} what they were thinking.

Triggers.Summary: {farmer} stocked up on beer at the Stardrop Saloon.

Triggers.Reaction: You were just struck with a real weapon. You are scared and furious: demand an explanation and an apology from {farmer}.
